summaries.zh: MIT研究员借助GPT-5.6 Sol与Codex，自主运行量子计算实验、分析结果并校准量子比特。该应用展示了AI在科研自动化中的实际潜力，不仅处理实验流程，还能从数据中提取洞见并优化量子硬件参数，从而提升实验效率与可靠性。这一实践体现了大语言模型与编程工具结合，正加速量子计算研究进程。
summaries.en: An MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol, paired with Codex, to autonomously operate quantum computing experiments. The AI assists in running the experiments, analyzing the results, and calibrating qubits, streamlining tasks that typically require manual intervention. This demonstrates a practical application of advanced AI in quantum research, improving efficiency in handling complex experimental procedures.

items.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
items.content: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.

summaries.en: OpenAI, together with AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA, has launched an AI program aimed at supporting Ukrainian news organizations. The initiative is designed to help these outlets bolster their innovation, strengthen resilience, and sustain independent journalism amid challenging conditions. The partnership underscores a collaborative effort to equip the Ukrainian press with technological tools and resources.
